text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please have a look.
I have received a fan letter~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The letter Mejiro Bright showed me was filled with lines of strikingly elegant calligraphy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's from an elderly fan~
Apparently, they've been supporting the Mejiro family
since my grandmother's time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Like taking root in the earth, slow and steady.
Yet her surefooted stride forward is truly worthy of carrying Mejiro's legacy"... it says.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but it is truly an honor.
To have them recognize me as a member of the Mejiro family and place their expectations upon me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sister Ryan, Lady McQueen,
and the generations before them who passed down
the long-standing history of the Mejiro family—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I, too, have been granted the opportunity
to carve my name into that glorious history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Without fail, I shall become an Umamusume
who carries the Mejiro name proudly on her shoulders~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It's a movement that “takes root in the earth”~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She went along at her usual easy pace,
but within her eyes burned what looked like an inner fighting spirit and pride.
